core.title: Pemko 60 Inch Eco-V Top Threshold, Pemko 206AV

text.description_html:
Pemko 206AV 60" Vinyl Top Threshold

This Pemko 250_V Adjustable Eco-V Top Threshold is furnished with weather-sealed mounting screws and adjustment mechanism. Vinyl seal section adjusts to overcome swelling and/or shrinking of door and floor. Vinyl-top creates a seal at the bottom of the door, eliminating the need for door sweeps or door shoes.

Specifications for Pemko 206 Residential Eco-V Top Thresholds:

  • Finish: Aluminum
  • Material: Anodized Aluminum
  • Vinyl Seal: Black
  • Overall Height with Seal: 3/4"
  • Threshold Height without Seal: 1/2"
  • Width: 3-1/4"
  • This threshold is supplied with a Vinyl ("V") insert.

Special ordered item. No Returns
